description: This file defines the Java interface 'DittoMongoClientBuilder' along with nested interfaces representing the stepwise builder pattern for constructing a 'DittoMongoClient'. It specifies configuration options for MongoDB clients, such as connection string, hostname, SSL, query time, connection pooling, listeners, and read preferences.

classes.name: DittoMongoClientBuilder
classes.description: Main interface for building 'DittoMongoClient' objects with step-wise configuration.

classes.name: ConnectionCoordinatesStep
classes.description: Interface for initial connection coordinate configuration, either via connection string or hostname and port.

classes.name: DatabaseNameStep
classes.description: Interface for setting default database name.

classes.name: GeneralPropertiesStep
classes.description: Interface for setting general MongoDB client properties such as SSL, query time, connection pool, listeners, and read preference.

methods.name: connectionString
methods.description: Sets the MongoDB connection string and proceeds to the next configuration step.

methods.name: hostnameAndPort
methods.description: Sets the host name and port number for MongoDB connection.

methods.name: defaultDatabaseName
methods.description: Sets the default database name for the client.

methods.name: enableSsl
methods.description: Enables or disables SSL for the connection.

methods.name: maxQueryTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum query duration for operations.

methods.name: connectionPoolMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: connectionPoolMaxWaitQueueSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum wait queue size for the connection pool.

methods.name: connectionPoolMaxWaitTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum wait time for a connection.

methods.name: enableJmxListener
methods.description: Enables or disables JMX connection pool listener.

methods.name: addConnectionPoolListener
methods.description: Adds a custom connection pool listener.

methods.name: setReadPreference
methods.description: Sets the read preference for the MongoDB client.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the configured 'DittoMongoClient' instance.
